|game_text=Deploy on opponent's just deployed [Reflections 3][Maintenance] card; opponent loses 1 Force, and you may retrieve 1 Force and/or play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect. That [Maintenance] card is power -3, may not apply its ability towards drawing battle destiny, and, during opponent's draw phase, opponent must lose 1 Force or place that card in Lost Pile. If just lost, place this card in Used Pile. Immune to [[Honor Of The Jedi]]. (Immune to [[Control]].) OR If you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2.

|errata_history=The printed title changed from “He Is Not Ready & Imperial Propaganda” to “He Is Not Ready (V)”. The game text shown on the two inspected slips is unchanged.<ref>[[:File:VB4-25E-He_Is_Not_Ready.png|Release slip]] and [[:File:VL-history-1240-26-front-master.png|master slip]].</ref> The Players Committee's own Holotable card data of 29 May 2010 already has the other wording (“Target is power -3 …”, the card-list text) under the title “He Is Not Ready & Imperial Propaganda”, stamped “(Errata Text - March 18th, 2009)”<ref name="cdf-20100529-dark">Players Committee Holotable card data file, “version 20100529” (darkside.cdf; card data, not a printed source), as committed on 13 July 2010 to [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/darkside.cdf ledwards/swccgvkit] (commit 5047de0)</ref>; with the card list's stamp “Errata text - March 18, 2010” this dates that wording to an errata of 18 March 2010 (He Is Not Ready's “2009” is almost certainly a slip, since Block 4 first came out in December 2009). The order of the two wordings and the title question are still held for a ruling (9 November 2026).
